meta.source: Reserve Bank of India, Database on Indian Economy (via the Data Bank)
meta.revisionPolicy: Provisional on release; partially revised with the next quarter's release and revised again later. DBIE keeps the first and the latest version of recent quarters; both are kept.
meta.product: International investment position of India, BPM5 (DBIE report 982)
meta.coverage: International investment position, old (BPM5) classification: what India owns abroad and owes to the world, by instrument and sector, in rupees
meta.note: RBI DBIE report 982, ₹ crore, stocks at the end of each quarter (plotted at the quarter's first month). The BPM5 classification, March 2006 to September 2021; replaced by BPM6 from December 2017. The overlap is two rulers, never joined. In December 2014 RBI's table gives a net position 8,233 US$ million away from assets minus liabilities; kept as published.
